title: Léo and the Order of the Golden Ladle
description: A secret order of chefs. A mystery in 1927 Paris. Enter the world of The Golden Ladle Chronicles.

title: The Venetian Gambit
description: Continue The Golden Ladle Chronicles with its second book, The Venetian Gambit.

title: The Sauce of Uncertainty
description: The third book in The Golden Ladle Chronicles.

title: The Scent of Secrets
description: Discover the fourth book in The Golden Ladle Chronicles.

title: The Queen’s Gambit
description: Five young apprentices. A medieval kingdom. Step into a world of magic and ancient secrets.

title: The Fractured Crown
description: Return to the world of Apprentices of Highwind in volume two.

description: Before Queen Aveline’s magical quests, a hidden network of apprentices kept Highwind Castle running. Discover an earlier chapter of Highwind in the first book of The Highwind Network.

title: Westvale: Where Weird Happens
description: Welcome to a town where the bizarre is part of everyday life. A collection of strange, funny stories.

title: Westvale: Even Weirder
description: Westvale returns with another collection of unusual tales in the second Westvale Tales book.

title: The Möbius Unit: Quantum Chaos and Other Adventures
description: Five middle schoolers use their scientific talents as secret agents of STEM. Join their missions in a collection bringing together Quantum Chaos and three novellas, where teamwork and clever thinking meet high-tech trouble.
